  • Destination
    • Lake Wörthersee
      Velden am Woerthersee Poertschach am Woerthersee Techelsberg Moosburg Krumpendorf Maria Wörth Schiefling
    • Keutschacher Seental

      Pure nature in the Four Lakes Valley: camping, nude bathing and the fantastic view from the Pyramidenkogel make Keutschach am See unique – complemented by the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the prehistoric pile dwellings.

      Learn more
    • Rosental

      Where the Drau River glistens and the Karawanken Mountains are within reach: the Rosental Valley on Lake Wörthersee is synonymous with nature and exercise. Untouched landscapes and numerous cycling and hiking trails await you.

      Learn more

Roman Trail Bad Kleinkirchheim

It is suitable for first attempts as well as for extensive training sessions in nature

• Length: 8 kilometers + 2.5 km sport trail
• Elevation: between 1,068 and 1,076 meters
• Difficulty: moderate, varied trail
